scripts.test:rules:emulator: cd .. && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-money-manager "npm --prefix frontend run test:rules"
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:browser
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run verify:full && npx firebase-tools hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d
scripts.deploy:live: npm run verify:full && npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore:rules,hosting
scripts.lighthouse: npm run build && lhci autorun && lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.mobile.json
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
